title: Optimization of Fenton-like reaction pathways using Ov-containing ZnO@nitrogen-rich porous carbon: the electron transfer and 1O2 triggered non-radical process
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00749B, Paper
Zhenfeng Zhang, Tianli Xiong, Haihao Peng, Honglin Zhang, Siying He, Xuran Liu, Yanan Liu, Wenyi Feng, Zhaohui Yang, Weiping Xiong
There is not much research on how to control the PDS reaction pathway. This work reports that Ov-containing ZnO@nitrogen-rich porous carbon composites activate PDS to remove SMZ only through 1O2 and electron transfer.
